snippet.title: Steel Platoon | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Lead your forces through the Battle of Moscow in a realistic WWII real-time tactics game featuring persistent squads, deep army customization, and a branching campaign with a global map where every decision carries lasting consequences.

🎮 Wishlist now on Steam ➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/4731000/Steel_Platoon/
💬 Join the Discord Server ➡️ https://discord.gg/WkreJDDGgM
